actor: Humanoid whole-body control benchmark research group
job: Releasing and hardening a force-aware contact benchmark plus dataset, and promoting force-informed evaluation as standard practice for whole-body control.
outcome: An openly released, widely runnable force-aware benchmark (contact-force dataset plus Force-Aware Tracking Score) that other groups can adopt.
motivation: Establish force-aware evaluation as the field norm and show their metric exposes readiness gaps that no-force testing hides.

task.what: release benchmark, dataset, and Force-Aware Tracking Score
task.where: open-source repository plus academic publication venue
task.when: from the 2026 benchmark release through H1 2027
task.why: make force-aware evaluation adoptable by other groups
task.how: synchronized whole-body motion and hand-force capture; sim replay

job: Replicating and extending force-aware contact evaluation on their own whole-body controllers, then publishing results under active applied force.
outcome: A second, independent published result reporting whole-body control under active contact force rather than motion tracking alone.
motivation: Validate or challenge ThorArena's finding and stake an early claim in the emerging force-aware evaluation area.

task.what: evaluate policies under applied contact forces
task.where: physics simulation plus teleoperated force-capture rigs
task.why: confirm hidden gaps and normalize contact-force evaluation
task.how: ThorArena-style protocol and force-aware tracking metrics

actor: Commercial humanoid platform whole-body-control engineering team
job: Validating whole-body controllers under load-bearing contact for factory and warehouse deployment, and publicly reporting the force-aware results.
outcome: A leading humanoid platform's public report of whole-body control under active applied contact force.
motivation: No-force demos no longer prove readiness where factory workers inevitably lean on, push, or hand off to robots.

task.what: benchmark controllers under load-bearing human contact
task.where: internal simulation plus on-robot contact test cells
task.why: prove factory readiness under inevitable human contact
task.how: force-aware tracking metrics; contact-force test protocol
